notes: Single-loop drawing with one shunt branch; labels are written sideways (60 ohm, 8 ohm, 4H, 2A, 10V). Net map (coordinates in 512-space): n1 = the left rail -- top-left corner (72,42) down the left side to the bottom-left corner (78,426) and right along the bottom rail to the left (bar) terminal of V-DC 0; also the left lead of resistor 5 (60 ohm). n2 = right lead of resistor 5 to the left plate of capacitor 1 (the two long vertical plate strokes at x~215 and x~230; the symbol's bbox is clipped by the top edge but the plates are both visible). n3 = right plate of capacitor 1 -> top rail right to the T at (268,30) where the I-DC 2 (2A) branch drops (verified at 9x) -> on to the top-right corner (377,26) -> down to the top lead of resistor 4 (8 ohm). n4 = bottom lead of resistor 4 to the top lead of inductor 3 (4H) -- the two are in series in the right rail with nothing tapping between them. n5 = bottom rail right of V-DC 0: its + terminal -> right to the T at (267,419) where the I-DC 2 lower lead comes down -> on to (395,413) where the inductor 3 lower lead comes down. Judgment calls: (a) V-DC 0 is drawn with the bar on the left and + on the right, so terminal 0 is the left (n1) and terminal 1 the + side (n5); (b) I-DC 2's arrow points down, i.e. from n3 toward n5; its terminal 0 is the top lead; (c) horizontal parts listed left-then-right, vertical parts top-then-bottom, as drawn; (d) capacitor 1's bbox extends above the frame (y from -6.5) but the component itself is drawn and traceable, so it is NOT an off-frame case.
